cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import ipaddress, json, random, subprocess, time
rng=random.Random(3)
def addr(v): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))
BASE=0x20010db8000000000000000000000000
cases=[]
for c in range(4):
    initial=[["::/0",0],["2001:db8::/48",3]]
    for i in range(14998):
        initial.append([addr(BASE+i)+"/128", 5])
    bursts=[{'version':0,'repeat':1000,'addresses':[addr(BASE+rng.randrange(14998)) for _ in range(64)]} for b in range(4)]
    cases.append({'initial':initial,'transactions':[[]],'bursts':bursts,'cache_pages':12,
                  'costs':{'hit':1,'miss':17,'decode':[0,1,2]}})
payload=json.dumps({'cases':cases}).encode()
print('input bytes',len(payload))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','submission/main.py'],input=payload,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt=time.time()-t
print('rc',p.returncode,'%.2fs'%dt)
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('invalid' if 'error' in out else [c['objective'] for c in out['cases']])
EOF
